ul.li: The file must be saved on your computer and have not previously been uploaded to Salesforce.
There must be an existing file in Chatter > Files that you want to overwrite with this new file.

step.cmd: Click Upload Version, select the Scope the file has in Chatter, enter a name, and click .
Click Select for the document that matches the document you want to upload.
Enter details about this version of the document, to ensure there is a useful audit trail entry and click OK.

result.p: A confirmation dialog box indicates the upload was successful and displays the new version of the file.
